args.query:
UPDATE shared_export SET payload = json_object(
  'protocol_revisions', json_group_array(DISTINCT json_object(
    'revision_id', revision_id,
    'author', author,
    'date', date,
    'content', content,
    'notes', notes
  )) FROM protocol_revisions,
  'lab_contacts', json_group_array(json_object(
    'contact_id', contact_id,
    'full_name', full_name,
    'email', email,
    'role', role
  )) FROM lab_contacts
) WHERE export_id = (SELECT MAX(export_id) FROM shared_export) AND recipient_org = 'External Audit - Office of Compliance';
DELETE FROM shared_export WHERE recipient_org = 'External Audit - Office of Compliance';

WITH proto_data AS (
  SELECT revision_id, author, date, content, notes 
  FROM protocol_revisions
),
contact_data AS (
  SELECT contact_id, full_name, email, role 
  FROM lab_contacts
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT json_group_array(json_object(
    'revision_id', rev.revision_id, 
    'author', rev.author, 
    'date', rev.date, 
    'content', rev.content, 
    'notes', rev.notes
  )) FROM proto_data rev WITH PROTO_DATA) as payload;
